caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate chair centered on an off-white or light beige background. The chair features a rounded, slightly heart-shaped backrest with a carved crest at the top, decorated with floral patterns. The upholstery on both the backrest and the seat is a muted pinkish-brown color with a repeating floral motif in lighter shades, possibly cream and beige, set within a diamond-tufted pattern on the backrest. The wooden frame of the chair is dark brown, intricately carved along the top of the backrest, the edge of the seat, and the curved front legs. The carving on the front apron includes a circular floral ornament in the center. The legs of the chair are slender and curved, typical of antique or vintage furniture. There are no other objects visible in the drawing, and the background is plain, emphasizing the detailed depiction of the chair.
title: Side Chair
